comment: Every flattened path present on one side only must be declared here, or the run fails (K9). A pair compares the old path's value with the new path's value; none_equals is the Debug value a None on the old side stands for (the new field's clap default), so a family that leaves the name unset is not reported as unequal; a Some(..) on either side compares by its inner value.

pairs.why: BILLING_MODE had two readers at rc.4 (the clap flag and the env copy BillingConfig.mode_env that the readiness gate read); HEAD reads only the clap-resolved value. Equal-effective whenever the flag is not given on argv.
ROLLUP: the same reader split as BILLING_MODE.

PATH_PREFIX had two readers (the clap value for the stores and the rollup, the environment copy BillingConfig.path_prefix_env for the read spool); HEAD reads only the clap value. Both sides are Options, so the pair compares their inner values. Equal-effective whenever the prefix is not given on argv.
